C0813.title: Zscaler Suffers Data Theft via Third-Party Platform Supply Chain Attack
C0813.summary: Zscaler disclosed that in August 2025 it experienced limited data exposure after a third-party marketing SaaS platform was affected by a supply chain attack. Attackers accessed some Salesforce business contacts, commercial information, and support case fields. Zscaler said the incident was limited to data associated with the third-party app and did not affect its products, services, or underlying systems.
